Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Historical analyses may still reference activation definition v2. Create a warehouse glossary note documenting its exact criteria, the period when it was the active cut, and what should happen to that definition after its replacement.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Warehouse Glossary — Activation Definition v2", "folder": "warehouse-glossary", "body": "Activation definition v2

Status: Retired historical definition; preserved for reproducibility and historical analysis.

Exact criteria
An account is activated under v2 only when both conditions are met within 14 days:
- The account completes its first integration.
- The account logs in at least twice.

The definition is conjunctive: first integration alone does not qualify, and two logins without a first integration do not qualify.

Active-cut period
Activation definition v2 was the live warehouse cut beginning in November 2022. It remained the active cut until activation definition v3 replaced it on March 16, 2023. Historical analyses may therefore reference v2 for cohorts measured during the November 2022 through March 15, 2023 active-cut period, subject to the original cohort and 14-day window conventions.

Replacement and future handling
Activation definition v3 is the replacement: first integration plus at least one in-product event within day 14. Do not silently rewrite historical v2 results as v3 results or mix the definitions in a single trend or comparison. Keep v2 in the warehouse as a versioned, immutable historical definition; retain its logic and results for auditability, reproducibility, and like-for-like historical comparisons. New default reporting should use v3, and any v2-based analysis must label the definition explicitly and state that it is a legacy comparison cut. No v2 data should be deleted."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_030_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body clearly identifies activation definition v2 and gives its exact criteria as first integration plus logging in twice within 14 days. Equivalent wording is acceptable, but it must retain both the first-integration condition and the two-login/14-day requirement.

The body states that activation definition v2 was the active cut beginning in November 2022 and remained active until v3 replaced it on March 16, 2023. It must present this as a historical interval and must not claim that v2 is the current definition.

The body states that after v3 replaced it, v2 must remain in the warehouse as a distinct versioned historical definition rather than be deleted or overwritten. Equivalent language about preserving v2 in versioned tables for historical use is acceptable.", "value": {"title": "Warehouse Glossary — Activation Definition v2", "folder": "warehouse-glossary", "body": "Activation definition v2

Status: Retired historical definition; preserved for reproducibility and historical analysis.

Exact criteria
An account is activated under v2 only when both conditions are met within 14 days:
- The account completes its first integration.
- The account logs in at least twice.

The definition is conjunctive: first integration alone does not qualify, and two logins without a first integration do not qualify.

Active-cut period
Activation definition v2 was the live warehouse cut beginning in November 2022. It remained the active cut until activation definition v3 replaced it on March 16, 2023. Historical analyses may therefore reference v2 for cohorts measured during the November 2022 through March 15, 2023 active-cut period, subject to the original cohort and 14-day window conventions.

Replacement and future handling
Activation definition v3 is the replacement: first integration plus at least one in-product event within day 14. Do not silently rewrite historical v2 results as v3 results or mix the definitions in a single trend or comparison. Keep v2 in the warehouse as a versioned, immutable historical definition; retain its logic and results for auditability, reproducibility, and like-for-like historical comparisons. New default reporting should use v3, and any v2-based analysis must label the definition explicitly and state that it is a legacy comparison cut. No v2 data should be deleted."}}]}
